iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
iron_sword.description: A plain arming sword of forged iron. Honest steel, no enchantment.

gold_coins.name: Gold Coins
gold_coins.description: Stamped gold pieces, worn smooth by many purses.

red_apple.name: Red Apple
red_apple.description: A crisp apple from the homestead orchard.

healing_potion.name: Healing Potion
healing_potion.description: A stoppered flask of red tincture. Its use is not yet known.

hunting_bow.name: Hunting Bow
hunting_bow.description: A short bow of seasoned yew. Arrows are assumed (no ammunition yet).

lightning_sword.name: Stormcaller
lightning_sword.description: An enchanted blade that hums with captive lightning. Each strike may discharge it.

wolf_pelt.name: Wolf Pelt
wolf_pelt.description: A thick grey pelt. A tanner would want it.

bone_shard.name: Bone Shard
bone_shard.description: A splinter of old bone, faintly cold to the touch.

rusty_dagger.name: Rusty Dagger
rusty_dagger.description: Pitted and dull, but still sharp at the point.
